text: Great place for retirement and care. Girls and boys welcome. Reasonable price. Good nursing home

A hospital with a well-planned layout based on architectural principles and a 110-year-old landscaping system...
It's truly amazing, and shady with hundreds of large trees. Nature's creation provides perfect shade and beautiful lines...
The most shady hospital with a resort-like atmosphere...awesome👍👍👍

I had the opportunity to visit the McCain Senior Citizens' Institute in mid-2019 to learn about its history and mission. I was very impressed by the spacious, peaceful, and serene atmosphere. Besides its long and fascinating history, the staff were very friendly and informative. The senior citizens I visited seemed very happy, and it was interesting to see that many retired international residents choose this place to spend their later years.
My father came to see a doctor here 50 years ago. As a child, I used to run and play here. Many of the buildings remain unchanged from the past.
I went inside and saw a very old room. The person living there seemed to be very lonely, but the trees provided nice shade.

Food is a bit scarce in the late morning.
There's some food on the street in the early mornings and evenings.
I was impressed with everything: the building, the location, the equipment, the landscaping, and the staff.

I went to many places but it didn't get better.
The doctor here is excellent.
I'm completely recovered now.
